items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The transcript discusses the interviewee's nickname 'Bud' and Duke Ellington's usage of it. There is no mention of a person named 'Bud' other than the interviewee himself, nor any interaction with a third party named Bud.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. We'll pick it up. She spoke loudly enough. There was something I want to know. Is your name Rose or is it Rosebud?

I was born Rosebud, and then they changed -- I changed it. All my family called me Bud, and everybody I knew in Washington, D.C., for a long time, called me Bud. That's how Duke Ellington got to calling me Rosebud; he always called me Rosebud.
I know Duke did; I didn't know whether Duke just called you that because he wanted to call you that because you and he were so close, or ...
